build.//: Override of the `build` target inferred by @nx/js/typescript (see that plugin's registration in nx.json for why the inferred `tsc --build tsconfig.lib.json` cannot run in this workspace). The trailing cp calls reproduce the `assets` globs the retired tsc build executor copied (generator templates + schemas); README/CHANGELOG are owned by the inferred `assets` target.

options.command: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p {projectRoot}/tsconfig.lib.json --outDir {projectRoot}/dist --rootDir {projectRoot} --baseUrl {projectRoot} --composite false --noEmitOnError && cp {projectRoot}/*.md {projectRoot}/generators.json {projectRoot}/dist/ && cp {projectRoot}/src/generators/registry-package/schema.json {projectRoot}/dist/src/generators/registry-package/ && cp -R {projectRoot}/src/generators/registry-package/__files__ {projectRoot}/dist/src/generators/registry-package/
